ordering: Follow LLD-01 idempotency/UoW order. Pure format/bound validation occurs before BEGIN IMMEDIATE; authoritative identity/relationship/revision checks rerun inside it.

commands.name: CreateManualServiceRequest
steps: validate optional official identity exactly eight digits
when official absent allocate next non-reusable LSR-######## and fail before mutation when allocator is at its exhausted sentinel
rules: official and local business IDs never become PKs
manual incomplete SR is valid; missing nonidentity facts do not block creation

commands.name: AttachOfficialServiceRequestIdentity
steps: inside UoW load same surviving SR and revalidate revision
validate exact eight-digit identity and prove it belongs to no other SR
require reviewed mapping; descriptive similarity cannot authorize
if exact official_sr_no already attached use semantic NO_CHANGE
rules: never replaces SR row
prior LSR remains permanently available
later Advanced Search exact identity reconciles to this SR

commands.name: CreateOrAdoptRfcIdentity
steps: if RFC exists return its immutable rfc_id to the owning reviewed adoption flow rather than create duplicate
otherwise validate optional Customer active via LLD-02
audit creation/provisional context without ever_imported flag
commands.rule: source adoption/provenance append itself is owned by reconciliation packet and must share or follow its exact accepted transaction contract

commands.name: SetRfcCustomer
steps: inside UoW load RFC/hierarchy branch and revalidate revision
validate non-null Customer is active LLD-02 identity
if exact requested Customer equals current use semantic NO_CHANGE
if known parent/child branch member has a different resolved Customer return RFC_CUSTOMER_MISMATCH
unresolved branch members remain warning not blocker
audit prior/new Customer and reviewed evidence
rules: Infrastructure evidence cannot call this as ownership authority
Customer names alone do not establish identity

commands.name: CreateDeviceReference
rules: equal names do not merge
Infrastructure registration is optional

commands.name: CorrectDeviceReferenceName
steps: if accepted text already equal use semantic NO_CHANGE
rules: does not create/reassign Network Element resolution
all operational links retain device_reference_id

commands.name: LinkServiceRequestToRfc
input: review context when terminal or historical
steps: inside UoW resolve supplied rfc_id to current root target; if action originated from subordinate require supplied governing root matches current hierarchy
revalidate the exact Service Request revision and governing-root RFC revision from sr_base_revision/rfc_base_revision together with current lifecycle projections/evidence
require root has no active parent
if active pair exists use semantic NO_CHANGE without fabricating a new review requirement and increment neither ticket revision

when creating a new relation and either current SR or RFC presentation is terminal/historical require explicit fresh reviewed context bound to the exact current lifecycle evidence and proposed root relationship
increment service_requests.revision and the governing-root rfcs.revision exactly once each and set both updated_at_utc values to the command whole-second time; do not alter either lifecycle
audit relationship and subordinate-origin provenance when applicable
rules: direct subordinate link rejected
terminal/historical SR or RFC may receive a new link only after explicit reviewed confirmation
applied bilateral SR-RFC relationship changes stale both ticket projections through their row revisions; Device Reference relationship mutations are not governed by this bilateral revision rule
linking never reopens/restarts either ticket, restarts SLA, restores Communications, or cascades lifecycle

commands.name: UnlinkServiceRequestFromRfc
steps: inside UoW load the exact Service Request and governing-root RFC and revalidate sr_base_revision/rfc_base_revision
if absent use semantic NO_CHANGE and increment neither ticket revision
transition active link to unlinked with closing provenance
increment service_requests.revision and the governing-root rfcs.revision exactly once each and set both updated_at_utc values to the command whole-second time
rules: no lifecycle mutation
history row remains protected
applied bilateral SR-RFC unlink stales both ticket projections through their row revisions; semantic NO_CHANGE changes neither revision

commands.name: LinkDeviceReference
steps: if active exact pair exists semantic NO_CHANGE
rules: RFC target may be root or subordinate
RFC need not have SR
relationship always targets Device Reference not Network Element

commands.name: UnlinkDeviceReference
steps: transition link to unlinked with provenance

commands.name: AddWorkingNote
steps: derive the authenticated singleton Local User Profile identity from trusted session context rather than client input
insert owner-specific note with immutable created_by_local_user_profile_id

commands.name: EditWorkingNote
steps: update body/revision/updated_at while preserving created_at and created_by_local_user_profile_id
audit prior/new content under bounded policy

commands.name: RemoveWorkingNote
steps: load/revalidate and capture prior body/creation time/creating Local User Profile identity
delete active note row through dedicated repository method
insert required audit carrying prior content/event chronology/creator reference under bounded audit policy
rules: source import cannot call this
removal is audited and does not fabricate a source deletion

delegated_command_files: RFC source/lifecycle, terminal cascade, archive-operation restore and hard delete -> commands/rfc-lifecycle.json
RFC hierarchy add/reparent/detach -> algorithms/rfc-hierarchy.json service contract
